courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 海水淡化取水工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「引水比例與季節工況機理與驗證」與「篩網方向與掃流機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；海水淡化取水工程的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Diversion fraction and seasonal states mechanism and verification" and "Screen orientation and sweeping flow mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seawater-desalination intake works must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以泥砂收支與局部水理協調河岸取水防淤；海水淡化取水工程則以取水水量、生物介面與海岸水力驗證為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on coordinating river-intake sediment budgets with local hydraulics; Seawater-desalination intake works centres on intake balances, biological interfaces and coastal hydraulic verification, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「引水比例與季節工況」與「產水需求與取水總量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到海水淡化取水工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「堵塞演變與水頭損失機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diversion fraction and seasonal states” and “Product demand and intake volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seawater-desalination intake works, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Clogging evolution and head loss mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 魚道水理設計

related.difference: 本課聚焦以泥砂收支與局部水理協調河岸取水防淤；魚道水理設計則以依魚種生命期解析通道水理、入口誘導與通過證據為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on coordinating river-intake sediment budgets with local hydraulics; Hydraulic design of fish passages centres on relating passage hydraulics and attraction to species, life stage and passage evidence, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「引水比例與季節工況」與「池間落差與射流」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到魚道水理設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「篩網接近速度比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diversion fraction and seasonal states” and “Pool drops and jet velocity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Hydraulic design of fish passages, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Screen approach velocity comparison", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 河岸取水口防淤設計
history.text: 墾務局於2006年發布取水魚類保護手冊，2009年補充現地水力評估方法，強調設施幾何、魚種及季節條件不能以單一規則取代。弗里波特區域設施於2011年完成，提供河岸取水與區域供水的案例；紅崖新抽水站及篩網於2012年九月實質完成並移交營運。本課不將早期紅崖研究抽水站與新工程混同，也不宣稱這些工程使用本課指定的沉砂池或沖砂流量。算例專供比較守恆與尺度。
history.textEn: Reclamation issued its fish-protection manual in 2006 and added field hydraulic-evaluation guidance in 2009, emphasizing site geometry, species and season rather than one universal rule. Freeport regional facilities were completed in 2011, illustrating river intake and regional supply. Red Bluff’s new pumping plant and screen reached substantial completion and operational transfer in September 2012. The earlier Red Bluff research pumping plant is not conflated with that new project, nor are lesson settling basins or flushing flows attributed to either project. Calculations compare conservation and scale only.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「引水比例與季節工況機理與驗證」到「實體模型相似限制機理與驗證」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Diversion fraction and seasonal states mechanism and verification" through "Physical-model similarity limits mechanism and verification" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
